title: phaseolus vulgaris var. humilis
intro: Phaseolus vulgaris var. humilis, commonly known as Mexican climbing bean or climbing runner bean, is a variety of the common bean plant. This plant is rich in nutrients and has been used for its health benefits, which include lowering cholesterol levels, regulating blood sugar levels, and aiding in weight management due to its high fiber content. The therapeutic actions of Phaseolus vulgaris var. humilis include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions. Its bioactive constituents include polyphenols, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
